title: Vendor components the launcher can download (launcher/src/data/vendor-components.json), format 1
description: Shipped with Kiln, read by the launcher (kiln_manage::vendor::manifest). Per component (AMD FSR, Intel XeSS, later NVIDIA's frame generation): what it is, its version, the vendor's licence (bundled verbatim next to this file) and every file with a tag-pinned URL on the vendor's own GitHub organisation, its size and its SHA-256. A file whose sha256 is "not-pinned" makes its whole component "not available in this build": it is never downloaded. tools/release/vendor_pin.py fills the hashes in from files the release process downloaded once. No key outside this schema (the manifest ships inside the build, so an unknown key is a typo). Rules the parser adds (not expressible here): ids unique, one component per vendor and version (they share a folder), URLs on the vendor's own organisation at a tag named after the version, the licence file bundled and its hash right. docs/kiln/launcher/contracts.md, "Vendor files".

vendor.description: The vendor: the folder kiln/vendor/<vendor>/ and the key of the licence agreements.

vendorName.description: The vendor as the page names it (AMD, Intel, NVIDIA).

name.description: The display name (AMD FSR). Never "DLSS" for anything that is not NVIDIA's.

enables.description: What it enables, one plain sentence.

version.description: The vendor's version; the folder kiln/vendor/<vendor>/<version>/, and the tag of every URL is this version or v<version>.

source.description: The vendor's release page (shown, opened in the browser; never fetched).

name.description: The licence's own name, as the vendor names it (MIT licence; Intel Simplified Software License (October 2022)).

file.description: The bundled text, relative to this file: the vendor's words verbatim, with LF line ends.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bundled text (UTF-8, LF line ends). The player's agreement is recorded with it; a changed text asks again.

from.description: Where the text is in the vendor's repository, at the same tag.

name.description: The file's name in kiln/vendor/<vendor>/<version>/ (no folder, no trailing dot; the parser also refuses Windows device names and Kiln's own names there).

url.description: A raw file at a tag (raw.githubusercontent.com/<org>/<repo>/<tag>/<path>), a Git LFS file at a tag (media.githubusercontent.com/media/<org>/<repo>/<tag>/<path>) or a release asset (github.com/<org>/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<asset>).

size.description: Bytes. Also the most a download may send.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256, or "not-pinned" until the release process pinned it.

gitBlob.description: The git blob SHA-1 of the file at the tag (GitHub's contents API): the pinning tool checks a downloaded file against it before it writes the sha256.
